title: Call-backs and salesperson guidance
summary: The topic groups follow-up calls, dealer guidance, and salesperson explanations, but the fragments are brief process notes rather than clear evaluative feedback.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention writers or dealers calling customers back, advising reboots or next steps, and salespeople explaining features without enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence does not support a positive, negative, mixed, or neutral sentiment reading.
